title: 'Wajahnya kelihatan tenang' - Abang Allahyarham Norhazwani
summary: Tumpat: “Walau ada sedikit kesan luka di tepi muka tapi wajahnya kelihatan tenang,” kata Mohd Hazwan Ibrahim, 38, abang kepada pegawai Agensi Kawalan dan Perlindungan Sempadan (AKPS), yang dipercayai dibunuh suaminya di sebuah rumah di Nilai, Negeri Sembilan, Khamis lalu.

title_en: 'He's face looks calm' - Deceased Norhazwani brother
summary_en: Tumpat: “Although there are some scars on the side of his face, he looks calm,” says Mohd Hazwan Ibrahim, 38, brother of a Border Control and Protection Agency (BKPSA) officer who was believed to have been killed by her husband in a house in Nilai, Negeri Sembilan last Thursday.
